# Adapter test fixtures

| Folder | Source |
|---|---|
| simulated | ONVIF answers recorded from the development kit's simulated camera, through the adapters' own ONVIF client |
| recorder | The simulated answers rewritten into a recorder with two video sources and two streams each |

The files hold no data of real devices: addresses are from 192.168.1.0/24 and every name and serial is made up.
